title: 第29章 天下英才，皆入大势力！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
临走前沈云又看了一眼虚空袋的价格，两立方的一百源石，四立方二百源石。

    打扰了。

    沈云拿着剩下的五枚源石回了灵农坊。

    先去段式符斋补充了符墨，继续投入篆刻大业之中。

    段掌柜看的摇头不已，沈老头还在努力呢？

    符墨用的挺快，源石浪费不少，符石一个未成。

    “从圣宝楼回来了，怎么样？”

    隔壁巧娘看到沈云回来，招呼道。

    “什么都没买，太贵了。”

    沈云尴尬的笑了笑，确实太贵了。

    “没买枚护体符石参照吗？”

    林巧娘惊讶不已，她还以为沈云是去圣宝楼买精品符石，用来学习比照。

    “没有，我去看了一些功法。”沈云摇了摇头。

    “其实你这种已经有功法修行，圣宝楼就不适合了，他们最多卖‘法’和‘诀’。”

    俏寡妇想到沈云去看了传承法门遇挫，不由得掩嘴轻笑笑。

    丰腴的身子一颤一颤。

    沈云不解，“那如何获得更高深的传承？”

    “当然是加入宗门了，直接用贡献兑换，宗门内都是优中选优的上佳法门。”巧娘理所当然的说道。

    “圣城中有两个获得传承的选择，一是圣宗，二是辅修入阶加入天工府。”

    “原来如此。”

    沈云明白过来，他就感觉圣宝楼功法贵的不正常。

    哪怕是最便宜的纸质版呼吸法，都能买圣城几套房了，这谁练的起。

    原来是这个缘故。

    掌握核心传承，天下英才，皆入大势力。

    散修没活路。

    高昂的功法价格，散修想要出头，难上加难。

    纵使侥幸走出一段距离，没有战法，宝器、天功、战法加持，散修也不是大势力弟子的对手。

    只能沦为背景板。

    看向院内迈着轻盈脚步玩耍的小女孩，沈云想到了什么，问道：“桐桐快十五岁了吧。”

    十五岁，就要修行了，届时肯定需要功法，不说玉晶功法，至少要一本纸质的入门。

    而且必须提前准备好。

    不然年纪到了，无论有没有机会拜入圣宗，到时候没有功法修行，都是平白耽误了孩子。

    至于道基四四以上直入圣宗，这种事太难，巧娘不抱希望。

    私下传授的代价，巧娘怕是承受不住。

    “没错，桐桐还有一年半就十五了。”
content_en:
Before leaving, Shen Yun took another look at the price of the void bag, which was one hundred Origin Stones for two cubic meters and two hundred Origin Stones for four cubic meters.

    Excuse me.

    Chen Yun took the remaining five Origin Stones and returned to Lingnongfang.

    First, I went to Duan Shi Fu Zhai to replenish the talisman ink, and then continued to devote myself to the great cause of seal cutting.

    Shopkeeper Duan shook his head. Is Old Shen still working hard?

    The rune ink was used very quickly, a lot of source stones were wasted, and not a single rune stone was completed.

    "You're back from the Holy Treasure Tower, how's it going?"

    Qiao Niang next door saw Shen Yun coming back and said hello.

    "I didn't buy anything, it was too expensive."

    Shen Yun smiled awkwardly, it was indeed too expensive.

    "Didn't you buy a protective rune stone for reference?"

    Lin Qiaoniang was surprised. She thought Shen Yun went to Shengbao Tower to buy high-quality rune stones for study and comparison.

    "No, I went to see some exercises." Shen Yun shook his head.

    "Actually, the Shengbao Tower is not suitable for people like you who have already practiced martial arts. They only sell 'methods' and 'techniques'."

    The pretty widow couldn't help but cover her mouth and smile softly when she thought of Shen Yun's setbacks after going to see the inheritance method.

    The plump body trembled.

    Chen Yun was puzzled, "Then how to obtain a deeper inheritance?"

    "Of course I have joined the sect and can directly redeem it with my contribution. The sect is full of the best methods to select the best." Qiao Niang said matter-of-factly.

    "There are two options for obtaining inheritance in the Holy City. One is the Holy Sect, and the other is to join the Tiangong Mansion as an assistant."

    "That's it."

    When Chen Yun understood, he felt that the Shengbaolou Kung Fu was unusually expensive.

    Even the cheapest paper version of the breathing method can buy several houses in the Holy City. Who can afford to practice it?

    It turned out to be the reason.

    Master the core inheritance, and all the talents in the world will join the big forces.

    There is no way out for casual cultivators.

    The high price of martial arts makes it even more difficult for casual cultivators to get ahead.

    Even if you are lucky enough to get out of a certain distance, without the blessing of fighting techniques, treasure weapons, heavenly skills, and fighting techniques, casual cultivators are no match for the disciples of big forces.

    It can only be reduced to a background board.

    Looking at the little girl playing with light steps in the courtyard, Shen Yun thought of something and asked, "Tongtong is almost fifteen years old."

    When you are fifteen, you will start to practice. At that time, you will definitely need the exercises. Not to mention the jade crystal exercises, you will at least need a paper introduction.

    And it must be prepared in advance.

    Otherwise, when the age is reached, no matter whether there is a chance to join the Holy Sect or not, if there is no Kung Fu practice at that time, the child will be wasted in vain.

    As for those with a Taoist foundation of 44 and above, entering the Holy Sect directly, this kind of thing is too difficult, Qiao Niang has no hope.

    Qiao Niang might not be able to bear the price of private teaching.

    "Yes, Tongtong will be fifteen in a year and a half."
title_en: Chapter 29 All the talented people in the world have joined the big powers!
